title: The Persistence of Healthy Behaviors in Food Purchasing
eligible_reason: Every reduced-form specification (Tables 3-4, appendix Tables C1-C10) regresses household-quarter outcomes on a bundle of treatment regressors (vWICPost2009 = on reformed WIC, vWIC = on WIC, vIndPostWICY12 / vIndPostWICY2L = 1-2 and 2+ years after leaving WIC, their interactions with the post-2009 cohort, and vAfter2009Change) together with time-varying household controls (child-age indicators, household size, log CPI-deflated income, and child-age x year terms for milk) in every column. WIC participation also switches off (households leave the program), so the treatment is not absorbing. The dCDH did_multiplegt estimates in appendix Table C5 / Figures C3-C4 use yearly collapsed data with controls and a treatment that switches on and off. Multiple treatment regressors plus mandatory time-varying controls violate the protocol.
design_notes: Nielsen Homescan household-quarter panel (data_regressions_tofromwic.dta, built from Nielsen HMS raw files, not shipped). Treatment: vWICPost2009 = vWIC * vAfter2009Change (on WIC after the October 2009 WIC food-package reform); households enter WIC in different years (vFirstYearWIC) and leave (vFirstYearOffWIC). Main regressions (table3_4_app.do lines 95-139): xtreg outcome `lVarlist' i.vCalendarQuarter if (vIndControlGroupSmall==1 | vSamplePostWICY2==1), fe cluster(household_code), where lVarlist = vWICPost2009 vWIC vIndPostWICY12 vIndPostWICY2L vInt2009_vIndPostWICY12 vInt2009_vIndPostWICY2L vAfter2009Change vIndChildAgeM1 vIndChildAge0-vIndChildAge5 vIndChild_6_12 vIndChild_13_17 household_size vLogIncomeCPI (+ vInterChildYr* for milk fat). Outcomes: whole-wheat bread volume share, milk fat percentage, log quantities of bread, milk, eggs, cereal, log calories of fruit/veg and juice. Table 4: milk fat by store-price-trend group with quarter and year FE. Appendix: WIC-only sample, separate post years, pre-trend terms (_IvTrXvTr*), negative-weights check restricting to households without post-WIC periods, PSM logit + matched regression, comparison-with-literature spec (lVarlist_Literature drops the reform interactions), did_multiplegt with controls, dynamic(2), placebo(2), 50 bootstrap reps. Remaining code is a structural demand model (mixlogit) and counterfactuals.
estimators_reported: de_chaisemartin_dhaultfoeuille (did_multiplegt, appendix Table C5, Figures C3-C4)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Households start WIC in different years (vFirstYearWIC; a robustness restricts to >= 2010), so adoption is staggered, but the count cannot be verified without the Nielsen data.
modern_estimators_named: de_chaisemartin_dhaultfoeuille (did_multiplegt, robust_dynamic, average_effect, controls()) - appendix Table C5 and Figures C3-C4

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying household controls in every column; multiple treatment regressors (on-WIC, reformed-WIC, post-WIC year bins and their cohort interactions); treatment switches off
specs.outcome: vMilkMeanFatPerc, vWWBreadVolShare, vLogQuantity_Bread, vLogQuantity_Milk, vLogCalories_FV, vLogCalories_Juice, vLogQuantity_Eggs, vLogQuantity_Cereal
specs.treatment_var: vWICPost2009 (= vWIC * vAfter2009Change) with vWIC, vIndPostWICY12, vIndPostWICY2L, vInt2009_vIndPostWICY12, vInt2009_vIndPostWICY2L, vAfter2009Change
specs.controls: vIndChildAgeM1 vIndChildAge0-vIndChildAge5 vIndChild_6_12 vIndChild_13_17 household_size vLogIncomeCPI (+ vInterChildYr* for milk)
specs.notes: Table 4 (lines 213-229) is the same for milk fat by price group with i.vQuarter i.panel_year.

specs.exclusion_reason: controls() in did_multiplegt; treatment switches on and off; appendix table
specs.treatment_var: vWICPost2009 (rounded to 0/1 at the household-year level)
specs.controls: vWIC child-age indicators household_size vLogIncomeCPI vIndPostWICY12 vIndPostWICY2L
specs.sample_condition: standard sample, drop years after leaving WIC for post-2009 WIC households

data_files_note: Only auxiliary public files are shipped (data/additional: USDA Products.csv and Nutrients.csv, CPI series, federal poverty guidelines, state shapefile). Nielsen Consumer Panel (Kilts Center) raw files must be placed in data/raw and rebuilt with 01_main_data_build.do.
software_note: Stata 16: xtreg, did_multiplegt, estout, mixlogit, spmap
screener_notes: The treatment of interest is a program-regime indicator (on WIC after the 2009 reform) embedded in a multi-regressor during/after specification with mandatory household covariates; no column reports a bare binary-treatment TWFE. Not eligible; Nielsen data not shipped in any case.
